Crew made simpler: one switch to stay staffed, and reserve staff that earn their keep

November 11, 2026 · By the Tailwinds team

Hiring crew meant four cards, four hire buttons and a lot of small print, and staff you had spare were invisible. The crew page under Operations has been rebuilt around one Staffing card. This applies to every game that hires its own crew.

  • One Staffing card. Each group gets a row: people on the line against people needed, who is short or spare, who is in training, and what it costs. The detail for each group now sits behind Show details.
  • Keep me fully staffed. Tick it and the hiring is done for you. Leavers are replaced before they are missed, and aircraft on order are crewed in time for delivery, at the normal training cost. It is on by default in new games and one tick away in existing ones.
  • Crew on the order form. Ordering or leasing an aircraft now shows the crew it needs, what they cost to train, and how many your spare staff already cover. You can switch Keep me fully staffed on from there.
  • Hire everything needed. If you prefer to hire by hand, one button makes the right hire for all four groups at once.
  • Spare staff are now reserve staff. Trained people above what your fleet needs used to cost nothing and do nothing. They are now paid half a normal wage, and in return they lift morale (up to 4 points at a 10% reserve), lift your on-time rate (up to 2 points) and cut meltdown risk.
  • A reserve level for each group. Choose none, 2%, 5%, 10%, 15% or 20% for pilots, cabin crew, ground staff and maintenance separately. Keep me fully staffed hires up to it. A deeper reserve also means a new aircraft can fly the week it arrives instead of waiting on a pilot course, which matters when you expand in a hurry.
  • Spare crews in aircraft. The card says how many more of your usual aircraft your reserves could crew today, so a line like "172 spare pilots" means something.
  • Release staff you do not want. After selling aircraft, or buying an airline for its fleet, you can let go the staff above your reserve level for four weeks' pay each. Leave them and they are simply not replaced as they move on. Nobody your aircraft need can be released.
  • Or have it done for you. Tick Release staff above my reserve level and, at the end of each week, anyone your fleet and your aircraft on order do not need is let go at the same severance. Staff in training are never released, and it never undoes a hire Keep me fully staffed has made. It is off by default.
  • The wage figures match the accounts. The crew cards and the Finance page now show each group's bill sized on aircraft size, the way it is charged, with reserve pay listed separately.

If your save is carrying a lot of spare staff, you will get a one-time note the first week reserve pay is charged, with the amount.
